name: cc-grammar-coach
description: Out-of-band English grammar checker (UserPromptSubmit hook) that logs your mistakes and shows optional statusline feedback, plus a drill skill that turns the log into a lesson-and-quiz web page.

native_language.title: Native language
native_language.description: Your native language, used by the drill skill to explain English grammar with contrasts you will recognize. Leave empty for generic, language-neutral lessons.

rephrase.title: Suggest rephrasings
rephrase.description: When enabled, the checker may append a single more-natural rewrite of the whole message when it is clearly awkward. Grammar flags are shown regardless of this setting.

show_feedback.title: Show statusline feedback
show_feedback.description: When enabled, checker feedback is written for the statusline to display. Disable to keep logging mistakes for the drill without any on-screen feedback.

llm_base_url.title: LLM base URL
llm_base_url.description: OpenAI-compatible chat-completions endpoint base URL for the checker. Leave empty to fall back to the local `claude -p` (haiku) CLI.

llm_model.title: LLM model
llm_model.description: Model identifier passed to the checker endpoint.

llm_api_key.title: LLM API key
llm_api_key.description: API key for the checker endpoint. Stored outside settings.json and injected into the hook environment only.
